dependencies.supplement: Actual0.19.0 package declaresMIT but omitsfullLICENSE. Previously reviewed official StyleX rootMIT supplement reused from existing AstryX license cache, not claimed file shipped inside npm.

adaptation: Original fixed Meta AstryX documentation examples with original core components. Field and Layout retain complete original functions; Markdown combines original inline example with a disclosed local fixed heading/list fixture; Timer combines original elapsed/clock/inherit snippets in one family. Banner retains original async outcome handler, while its undefined saveSettings is supplied by a disclosed local resolved/rejected fixture plus failure toggle: no real settings are saved. Layout navigation and order details are original static illustrations, not a working order system; Field controls update local state without filtering a server. Documentation workspace0.7.12 with installedcore/theme/build0.7.11 compatibility runtime, exact emitted dependencies below. Same original StyleX/theme/LayerProvider; each entry independent IIFE. Imports/function wrapper/default export are adaptation, no original component redrawing. No external media, network, user storage, accounts, clipboard or backend. Markdown accepts only hardcoded trusted sample strings; not a general untrusted content editor/security claim. Hidden unmounts transient state, visible remounts fresh; Timer restarts elapsed measurement. Exit/error own listener/observer/frame/timer cleanup. Actual550compose and loader/cache/release, original key interactions tested under JSDOM; StyleX CSS parsing unsupported warning recorded separately, no native layout/pixels verified. Root MIT and actual emitted dependency full licenses included; core and StyleX missing-file official supplements expressly labelled, not claimed npm shipped them.
